description: Start a background job that proposes search keywords for a project from a seed (a topic, a product, a URL). excludeQueries leaves out ones already tracked. Poll get_job for the result, review it with the user, then track the chosen ones with create_tracked_queries. Requires an active subscription.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.

name: discover_keywords
title: Discover search keywords
